messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.

As of 15 July 2023, was Chapter VI of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 already in force in place of Article 11 of Directive 2006/42/EC for products that had been placed on the market in conformity with the Directive?

response.text: Alla data del 15 luglio 2023, il Capo VI del Regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 era già in vigore in sostituzione dell'articolo 11 della direttiva 2006/42/CE per i prodotti immessi sul mercato in conformità alla direttiva?
